var policyTraces = []struct { name, text, sha256 string }{
//TRACES
}

// TestDeclaredTraces executes every physical trace row against the closed runtime.
// Expected IO is complete and ordered; a missing intention or extra effect fails.
func TestDeclaredTraces(t *testing.T) {
    for _, source := range policyTraces { t.Run(source.name,func(t *testing.T) {
        var rows []struct { Line int `json:"line"`; Trace string `json:"trace"`; Step int `json:"step"`; T float64 `json:"t"`; Event string `json:"event"`; Expect string `json:"expect"` }
        if e:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(source.text),&rows); e!=nil || len(rows)==0 { t.Fatal("trace rows:",e) }
        var run *Run
        trace := ""; step := 0; seen := map[string]bool{}
        for _,row := range rows {
            n,at:=row.Step,row.T
            var e error
            kind,payload,_ := strings.Cut(row.Event," ")
            if strings.TrimSpace(payload)=="" && kind!="advance" { payload="{}" }
            if kind=="advance" { payload=strings.TrimSpace(payload) }
            if row.Trace!=trace {
                if seen[row.Trace] || n!=0 || kind!="input" { t.Fatalf("line %d: fresh trace input",row.Line) }
                seen[row.Trace]=true; trace=row.Trace; step=0
                run,e=Open(source.name,[]byte(payload),at)
            } else {
                step++; if n!=step || kind=="input" { t.Fatalf("%s: step %d, want %d",trace,n,step) }
                _,e=run.Step(at,kind,[]byte(payload))
            }
            if e!=nil { t.Fatalf("%s/%d: %v",trace,n,e) }
            if e:=checkTrace(run.Snapshot(),row.Expect); e!=nil { t.Fatalf("%s/%d: %v",trace,n,e) }
        }
    }) }
}

func assertionParts(text string) ([]string,error) {
    out:=[]string{}; start,depth:=0,0; quote,escape:=false,false
    for i,ch:=range text {
        if quote { if escape { escape=false } else if ch=='\\' { escape=true } else if ch=='"' { quote=false }; continue }
        switch ch { case '"': quote=true; case '[','{': depth++; case ']','}': depth--; case ';': if depth==0 { out=append(out,strings.TrimSpace(text[start:i])); start=i+1 } }
        if depth<0 { return nil,fmt.Errorf("unbalanced assertion") }
    }
    if quote || depth!=0 { return nil,fmt.Errorf("unbalanced assertion") }
    return append(out,strings.TrimSpace(text[start:])),nil
}

func checkTrace(got Observation,text string) error {
    parts,e:=assertionParts(text); if e!=nil { return e }
    for _,part:=range parts {
        key,value,ok:=strings.Cut(part,"="); if !ok { return fmt.Errorf("assertion %q",part) }
        key=strings.TrimSpace(key); value=strings.TrimSpace(value)
        var actual,want any
        switch {
        case key=="state": actual=got.State; want=value
        case key=="io": raw,e:=json.Marshal(got.IO); if e!=nil { return e }; actual,e=DecodeJSON(raw); if e!=nil { return e }; want,e=DecodeJSON([]byte(value)); if e!=nil { return e }
        case strings.HasPrefix(key,"var."): var found bool; actual,found=got.Vars[strings.TrimPrefix(key,"var.")]; if !found { return fmt.Errorf("unknown assertion variable %s",key) }; want,e=DecodeJSON([]byte(value)); if e!=nil { return e }
        default: return fmt.Errorf("unsupported assertion %s",key)
        }
        if !jsonEqual(actual,want) { return fmt.Errorf("%s: got %#v, want %#v",key,actual,want) }
    }
    return nil
}

func jsonEqual(a,b any) bool {
    // Compare JSON numbers by value without converting integer guards to float64.
    number:=func(x any) (*big.Rat,bool) { var s string; switch v:=x.(type) { case int64: s=strconv.FormatInt(v,10); case float64: s=strconv.FormatFloat(v,'g',-1,64); case json.Number: s=string(v); default: return nil,false }; r,ok:=new(big.Rat).SetString(s); return r,ok }
    if x,ok:=number(a); ok { y,ok:=number(b); return ok && x.Cmp(y)==0 }
    switch x:=a.(type) {
    case nil: return b==nil
    case bool: y,ok:=b.(bool); return ok && x==y
    case string: y,ok:=b.(string); return ok && x==y
    case []any: y,ok:=b.([]any); if !ok || len(x)!=len(y) { return false }; for i:=range x { if !jsonEqual(x[i],y[i]) { return false } }; return true
    case map[string]any: y,ok:=b.(map[string]any); if !ok || len(x)!=len(y) { return false }; for k,v:=range x { w,ok:=y[k]; if !ok || !jsonEqual(v,w) { return false } }; return true
    }
    return false
}
